title.zh: MCP 范例库：按曲风的可模仿配方 + few-shot 提示
title.en: MCP example library: imitable recipes per genre, plus a few-shot prompt

highlights.zh: get_example 与 groove://examples/{genre}：每个范例自带产生它的工具调用序列。
highlights.en: get_example and groove://examples/{genre}: each example carries the tool calls that produced it.

highlights.zh: 范例由曲风库构建而非粘贴，因此不会随曲风变化而漂移，且都通过 validate_pattern。
highlights.en: Examples are built from the genre library rather than pasted, so they cannot drift, and every one passes validate_pattern.

highlights.zh: 新增 compose_with_examples 提示：先读配方再动手，并提醒 undo_song 让实验不必永久。
highlights.en: New compose_with_examples prompt: read a recipe before writing, and undo_song so an experiment need not be permanent.

title.zh: MCP 新增：撤销、和声、旋律与声调检查
title.en: MCP gains undo, harmony, melody and a prosody check

highlights.zh: undo_song：每次改动都有 opId，get_song 列出可回退的历史。
highlights.en: undo_song: every change carries an opId, and get_song lists what is undoable.

highlights.zh: set_chord_progression / suggest_progression：按情绪挑选进行并渲染到指定调。
highlights.en: set_chord_progression and suggest_progression: choose a progression by emotion and render it in a key.

highlights.zh: generate_melody（轮廓优先、AABA、音域受限）与 validate_prosody（倒字只警告）。
highlights.en: generate_melody (contour-first, AABA, range-bounded) and validate_prosody (倒字, advisory).

title.zh: 四槽编辑器上线；修 MCP 的 clips 与时长估计；包格式规范
title.en: Four-slot editor; MCP clips and duration fixes; the package format spec

highlights.zh: 编辑器槽位与复制控件支持 A–D，切到空槽会创建并保留，工程保存也带上它们。
highlights.en: The editor's slot and copy controls cover A–D; switching to an empty slot creates and keeps it, and saving carries them.

highlights.zh: 修复 create_song 的 clips 只传部分槽位被拒、secondsEstimate 低估四倍、导出文件名的中文塌陷。
highlights.en: Fixed create_song refusing a partial clips object, secondsEstimate reading four times low, and Chinese titles collapsing in file names.

highlights.zh: 新增 .groove 包格式规范（校验规则与版本兼容承诺），并记录 A4 的纹理轨测量结论。
highlights.en: Added the .groove package specification with its validation rules and compatibility commitment, and recorded A4's texture-lane measurement.

title.zh: 编辑器支持四个 clip 槽位；MCP 两处修复
title.en: The editor holds four clip slots; two MCP fixes

highlights.zh: 槽位控件与复制控件支持 A–D，切到空槽会自动创建并保留。
highlights.en: The slot and copy controls work across A–D; switching to an empty slot creates and keeps it.

highlights.zh: 修复 create_song 的 clips 只传部分槽位会被拒，以及 secondsEstimate 低估四倍。
highlights.en: Fixed create_song refusing a partial clips object, and secondsEstimate reading four times too low.

highlights.zh: 新增 .groove 包格式规范文档（含版本兼容承诺）。
highlights.en: Added the .groove package format specification, with its compatibility commitment.

title.zh: MCP 作曲闭环：Ableton 一节一 clip、工程包可导入
title.en: MCP composition closes the loop: one Ableton clip per section, importable packages, duplicate_section

highlights.zh: 导出 Ableton 时一首歌变成「一段一个 scene」，scene 名即段落名。
highlights.en: Ableton export makes one clip per scene, each named after its section.

highlights.zh: 新增 import_groove：把 .groove 包读回、经校验后继续编辑。
highlights.en: New import_groove: read a .groove package back and continue editing it.

highlights.zh: 新增 duplicate_section 与 render_song 的 maxDurationSec 护栏。
highlights.en: New duplicate_section and render_song's maxDurationSec guard.

title.zh: 响度基线改为在 CI 上重录（159 曲风）并应用，配平更准
title.en: The loudness baseline was re-recorded on CI (159 genres) and applied

highlights.zh: 159 个曲风的响度基线在 GitHub 上分块重录完成（每块独立进程），报告作为证据一并入库。
highlights.en: All 159 genres were re-recorded in chunks on GitHub (a fresh process per chunk), with the report committed as the evidence.

highlights.zh: 跨曲风响度分布进一步收窄：p90−p10 5.69 dB、全距 11.8 dB；音色与响度门禁均通过。
highlights.en: The cross-genre spread tightened to p90−p10 5.69 dB and an 11.8 dB full range; the timbre and loudness gates both pass.

title.zh: MCP 作曲打通：可做变奏、可读回、可导出工程包
title.en: MCP composition: set_clip, get_song and export_groove — songs can vary, be read back and be exported

highlights.zh: 新增 set_clip：不再只能有 clip A，主歌/副歌变奏可用；create_song 也接受 clips 与首段 label。
highlights.en: New set_clip: no longer limited to clip A, so verse/chorus variations work; create_song takes clips and a first-section label.

highlights.zh: 新增 get_song 与 export_groove：编排可读回，并导出为校验过的 .groove 包（编排随包保留）。
highlights.en: New get_song and export_groove: the arrangement can be read back and exported as a validated .groove package, carried rather than flattened.

highlights.zh: 渲染文件名可用自己的歌名（白名单后拼接）；MCP 文档重复段落与断表已修。
highlights.en: A render can be named after your own song title (whitelisted); the duplicated MCP docs section is fixed.

title.zh: 修好每个音符事件处的爆音（GS-1 分块输出错位）
title.en: The click at every note event is gone — a split block was assembled wrong

highlights.zh: GS-1 引擎把被事件切开的音频块按每块自己的位置拼接，之前会把最后一块放到块首并留下残留数据。
highlights.en: The GS-1 engine now assembles an event-split audio block per chunk; it used to place the last chunk at the start of the block and leave stale data behind.

highlights.zh: 实测：该分轨的高频包络离群值由 181.6×/153.6×/134.5× 变为「无异常」，全频段最大步进降到 1.19× p99.9。
highlights.en: Measured: the stem's high-frequency outlier went from 181.6x/153.6x/134.5x to none, with the full-band worst step at 1.19x p99.9.

highlights.zh: 响度与音色基线在修复后仍然通过，分布不变。
highlights.en: The loudness and timbre baselines still pass after the fix, with the spreads unchanged.

title.zh: 冷启动不再黑屏、图片提前加载、混响送出收低频、锁屏可恢复、发布包更干净
title.en: No black screen on a cold start, warmed artwork, a shaped reverb send, lock-screen resume, and no cover tooling in the payload

highlights.zh: 首次打开不再黑屏：文档自带内联首屏，React 挂载后接管。
highlights.en: A cold launch no longer shows a black screen: the document draws its own inline first frame until React takes over.

highlights.zh: 图片提前取好并解码：曲库、详情与黑胶标签不再等到显示时才下载。
highlights.en: Artwork is fetched and decoded before the paint: library, detail and the vinyl label no longer download on appearance.

highlights.zh: 混响送出加 160Hz 高通：低频立体声成分实测减少 2.8 dB，整轨仅变化 0.001 dB。
highlights.en: The reverb send is high-passed at 160 Hz: 2.8 dB less low-frequency side energy, with the mix moving 0.001 dB.

highlights.zh: 锁屏后可恢复，安卓同样生效；发布包不再带封面制作垃圾。
highlights.en: Audio resumes after a lock screen, on Android too; cover tooling is no longer published.

title.zh: 手机播放条常驻，曲库改用 256px 缩略图
title.en: A permanent phone player bar, and 256px cover thumbnails for the library

highlights.zh: 首页播放条不再「点了才出现」：常驻原位，以默认曲风预填名称/BPM/封面/播放键，停止后保留最后听的曲风。
highlights.en: The phone player bar is permanent: seeded with the default genre (name, BPM, cover, play control), and it keeps naming the last genre after the transport stops.

highlights.zh: 曲库封面改为 256×256 缩略图并异步解码：原来每张磁贴解码 1024×1024（130–626KB）只画 56px，实测单张 626570→16729 字节。
highlights.en: Cover art is a 256x256 thumbnail decoded asynchronously: tiles decoded 1024x1024 (130-626 KB) to draw 56px, measured at 626570 to 16729 bytes.
